verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own docs state the product is available self-hosted as well as in-VPC, alongside the managed API, so the core capability is claimed first-party. The evidence pack has only this one-line claim and nothing on how deployment actually works. Missing for 10: self-hosted deployment documentation (containers/installation, hardware/GPU requirements, licensing terms), confirmation of which models/features (STT, TTS, voice agent) run self-hosted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Available as a managed API (US, EU, and Australia endpoints), in-VPC, or self-hosted.
